# Ridgeline

> Ridgeline is a web app (installable PWA) for hiking trail maps that work offline. Find trails near you, see distance, climb, estimated time and difficulty, save a trail's map to your phone, navigate with live GPS and record hikes as GPX files. Accounts are optional (Google or Apple). Without one, saved trails, recordings and live GPS position stay on the device; if you sign in, saved trails, hike history and routes (minus the first and last 200 m) are also stored in your account, and your live position is never sent to our servers. Place searches, trail data and map tiles are requested from third-party services for the area you look at.

Trail data comes from OpenStreetMap contributors (via Geofabrik extracts for Washington State and the Overpass API elsewhere). Map tiles come from OpenFreeMap. Elevation comes from Copernicus WorldDEM-90, computed when the app is built.

- App: https://hike.bbprojectfactory.com/
- Source code: https://github.com/mishamachine/ridgeline
